# @neural-ng/theme

PURPOSE
Compile a small Neural theme recipe into complete @neural-ng/core and
@neural-ng/editor CSS tokens, Tailwind bridge tokens, interchange JSON,
diagnostics, and a generated theme-name type.

INSTALL
npm install -D @neural-ng/theme

COMMANDS
npx neural-theme init
npx neural-theme init --preset glass
npx neural-theme init --preset mist
npx neural-theme init --preset futuristic
npx neural-theme validate
npx neural-theme build
npx neural-theme build --config company.theme.json --out-dir src/styles/generated
npx neural-theme migrate --config legacy.theme.json --out neural.theme.json

AUTHORING RULES
- Use neural.theme.json as the canonical sparse authoring format.
- Set name in lowercase kebab-case.
- extends must be neutral, glass, mist, or futuristic. Glass, Mist, and Futuristic are experimental baselines.
- Prefer color.primary, color.surface, typography, shape, density, elevation,
  and motion over exact component token overrides.
- Use components.<component>.<camelCaseTokenSuffix> only for sparse overrides.
- Use tokens.--neural-* only for advanced exact overrides.
- Override values must not contain semicolons, control characters, url(),
  @import, expression(), javascript:, or malformed token aliases.
- Use {color.primary}, {color.surface.50}, {button.radius}, or
  {components.button.radius} for aliases.
- Never generate the full 1,000+ token graph in a prompt. Let the compiler
  expand the compact recipe.
- Do not import Core neutral.css or Editor neutral.css together with generated
  theme CSS. The generated CSS already contains both contracts.
- Keep @neural-ng/theme as a dev dependency. Angular visual tooling may import
  only @neural-ng/theme/browser; never import the Node entry point into a browser
  bundle.

OUTPUT
<name>.css
<name>.tokens.json
<name>.report.json
<name>.d.ts

PROGRAMMATIC API
compileTheme
migrateThemeRecipe
validateThemeRecipe
loadThemeRecipe
writeThemeArtifacts
buildThemeFromFile
loadThemeContract
getComponentThemeContract
listThemeComponents


BROWSER STUDIO API
import from @neural-ng/theme/browser
compileTheme(recipe, { scope: 'theme', includeTailwind: false })
validateThemeRecipe(recipe)
getComponentThemeContract(component)
listThemeComponents()
listThemePresets()
getThemePreset()

THEME STUDIO
/docs/tools/theme-studio
- Uses the same generated contract and resolver as the CLI.
- Applies generated CSS only inside data-neural-theme scope.
- Supports compact recipe edit/import, built-in preset selection, component-scoped overrides, light/dark preview and artifact export.
- Imports legacy preview recipes through migrateThemeRecipe and exposes bounded undo/redo history.

MCP THEME WORKFLOW
- Use @neural-ng/mcp-server compact recipe tools for AI-assisted authoring.
- Keep edits sparse and component-scoped.
- Validate before build.
- Do not move full generated CSS or the 1,348-token graph through model context.

QUALITY GATE
- Neutral is release quality; Glass, Mist, and Futuristic are preview quality.
- Run npx nx run neural-theme:quality-check before release.
- Review CSS/token/report hash changes before updating presets/quality-baseline.json.
